title: verification_record misstates mode and command for category and live committed-input runs
outcome:
The verification_record body states the run's actual mode and launcher command:
- a `category NAME --input commit` run is sent as mode category, which Engram's producer accepts, not focused;
- a live run's command keeps its --engram-binary/--engram-sha256 arguments and test paths.
This is done either by recording the actual launcher argv in request.json, which the sender already prefers, or by rebuilding each mode faithfully. Today engram_verification_record_mode (src/engram_verification_record.rs ~689, from w-decd61d62831) maps every non-full, non-live run to focused, and engram_verification_record_run_command rebuilds a focused command. Provenance: w-decd delta review round 2, Low (Claude delegation 2d36d89c).
acceptance: verification_record misstates mode and command for category and live committed-input runs is done
